title: Growing open Markovian Jackson networks: Fluid limit and infinite-dimensional Skorokhod problem
summary: We study growing open Jackson networks where each station is a single-server queue that follows the first-come first-served discipline with Poisson arrivals and exponentially distributed service times, characterized by node-specific rates. In applying a fluid scaling to the queue-length process, we show that under certain conditions the queueing system can be approximated by an infinite-dimensional fluid limit with a kernel function in place of the transition matrix.
